notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32983174/1fa5fd5fcefc4c751fe771fd48b6899919be12a2.png[/img]
Dear AlienCats!

We are happy to announce that we've prepared an important update for the game! 

Here's a list of changes and improvements:
[list]
[*] More languages! We now support: English, Polish, French, Hungarian and Chinese
[*] Shooting and targeting was improved. Shooting is now done with Right Mouse Button. Learn how to fight effectively. Press LMB for walking and RMB for shooting and blocking!
[*] More pickups (first-aid kit & ammo) in hard levels
[*] Better-balanced enemies 
[*] Fixed navmeshes in multiple levels
[*] Adjusted scale of some enemies
[*] More ways to interact with the environment
[*] More hints in difficult locations
[*] Tons of bugfixes!
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sTuGIlo.gif[/img]

Have fun! ːsteamhappyː
